name: mono3d_blcs_bcast_v4_physics
command: MPLBACKEND=Agg PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True .venv/bin/python -m src.tasks.blcs.scripts.train --config-name train_chunked data.scene_dir=data/blcs_broadcast data.chunk.chunks_dir=data/blcs_broadcast/chunks data.num_views_range=[1,1] data.camera_mode=random data.num_court_kp=14 data.num_workers=2 data.chunk.generation_workers=8 data.chunk.epochs_per_chunk=20 camera=broadcast training.position_axis_weights=[1.0,4.0,1.0] training.smoothness_loss_weight=1.0 training.gravity_loss_weight=0.5 training.trainer.max_epochs=200 training.trainer.check_val_every_n_epoch=5 training.qualitative_logging.enabled=false run.gpus=1
